info.title: Evidentia API
info.description: Evidence platform for field media: signed Cloudinary ingestion, AI enrichment, verification and traceable reporting.

Response List Projects V1 Projects Get
Response List Sites V1 Projects  Project Id  Sites Get

post.description:
Register an upload intent and return server-built, signed Cloudinary upload parameters.

The browser POSTs the file plus `fields` directly to `upload_url` (chunked above `chunk_size`),
then calls `/v1/assets/{asset_id}/confirm` with Cloudinary's response.

Confirm a finished upload. Verified with the signature in Cloudinary's upload response;
idempotent with the upload webhook (whichever arrives first starts processing).

get.description: Return the complete provenance and transformation lineage for an evidence asset.
WebVTT chapters built from timestamped video observations.

post.description: Re-run AI enrichment as a new generation. Previous observations are kept (superseded).

Hybrid evidence search. Natural language is parsed into hard filters (site, dates, media type,
verification) plus text for lexical, semantic and visual retrieval, fused with RRF.

post.description:
Find before/after candidates: same site, PostGIS distance, baseline vs endline windows,
ranked by SigLIP similarity. Each new candidate is queued for geometric verification, alignment
and change detection; the ranking is final once those finish.

schema.title: Response List Pairs V1 Projects  Project Id  Before After Get

post.description: Compare two specific photos (queued for analysis like a suggested pair).
Re-run alignment and change detection (history of decisions is kept).
A reviewer confirms the photos show the same place: the pair becomes usable as evidence.
Generate social format campaign cards (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9) with mandatory redaction.

get.description: List all generated campaigns for a project.

post.description: Create a highlight reel stitched from cited video segments with fl_splice.
Create an external read-only share link.

get.description: List all active and historical share links for a project.

schema.title: Response List Share Links V1 Projects  Project Id  Share Links Get

delete.description: Revoke an active share link immediately.

schema.title: Response List Reports V1 Projects  Project Id  Reports Get

post.description: Without `claim_ids`, every approved claim overlapping the period (and site) is included.

Write the narrative from approved claims only. Sentences that fail the citation or number
checks are dropped and listed in `narrative_meta.rejected`.

put.description: Replace the narrative with an edited one. Rejected as a whole if any sentence fails.

post.description: Freeze an immutable, hashed snapshot and queue its PDF.

schema.title: Response List Snapshots V1 Reports  Report Id  Snapshots Get

get.description:
The frozen manifest: claims, evidence, observations with model versions, Cloudinary
public_ids and transformations, approvers.

schema.title: Response Manifest V1 Reports  Report Id  Snapshots  Version  Manifest Get

get.description: Re-render the stored manifest and compare both hashes with the ones taken at publish.
Short-lived signed download link for the PDF stored privately in Cloudinary (audited).

post.description: Queue the PDF again (after a failure, or once Cloudinary/Chromium are set up).

Photo -> verified observations -> claim with linked evidence -> AI-validated -> approved by
the separate Demo reviewer. A claim the validator rejects is left in review.
An existing claim: validate, submit and have the Demo reviewer approve it.
Every approved claim -> report -> cited narrative -> published snapshot + PDF.

Cloudinary notifications. Authenticated by signature (no bearer token).
